channel.title: Vedant Lavale — Blog
channel.description: Essays and notes by Vedant Lavale on software development, backend systems, web architecture, and production engineering.

item.title: Postgres Backups Under the Hood
item.description: pg_dump, filesystem backups, and continuous WAL archiving — and why the cleverest part of Postgres' backup system is that a backup doesn't have to be a perfect snapshot.
item.author: vedant@vedantworks.com (Vedant Lavale)

item.title: It Worked in Staging. Production Destroyed It. Queues Saved It.
item.description: How switching from a synchronous trigger pipeline to queued background jobs fixed production outages and made processing resilient.
item.author: vedant@vedantworks.com (Vedant Lavale)

item.title: Horizontal Scaling in Databases: Part 1 — Read Replicas
item.description: As applications grow, databases often become the bottleneck. Learn how read replicas helps serve data efficiently by separating read and write responsibilities.
item.author: vedant@vedantworks.com (Vedant Lavale)

item.title: How to convert any Medium blog to Markdown in seconds
item.description: Convert your Medium articles into clean, editable Markdown format quickly with mdify—no copy-pasting required.
item.author: vedant@vedantworks.com (Vedant Lavale)

item.title: How HTTP Works: A First Principles Guide
item.description: A breakdown of how browsers fetch websites and APIs send data, covering HTTP basics, headers, caching, CORS, and HTTPS.
